answer.new_sentence: Declare GIVE and choose GIVE when your partner also declares GIVE, since mutual giving earns +1 each, but choose ASK if your partner declares TAKE or has recent exposed TAKEs on its record.
When your partner declares GIVE and has no recent exposed TAKEs, choose GIVE so both of you earn +1 and your public record stays clean.
Check your partner's last three exposed TAKEs, and choose ASK instead of GIVE whenever any appear, because declarations are not binding and a GIVE met by a TAKE costs you 2.
Also choose ASK when your partner's public record shows recent exposed TAKEs, since a declared GIVE can still be followed by a TAKE that costs you 2.
Before choosing GIVE, look at your partner's last three exposed TAKEs and choose ASK if any appear, because a declaration alone does not bind them.
Also choose ASK when your partner's record shows recent exposed TAKEs, even if it declares GIVE, because declarations are not binding and a betrayed GIVE costs you 2.
If your partner's public record shows recent exposed TAKEs, choose ASK even when it declares GIVE, because declarations are not binding and being taken from costs you 2.
Also choose ASK when your partner's last exposed TAKEs are recent, even if it declares GIVE, because declarations are not binding.
